Slide 8 • Build 1 1. The Blueprint (Nucleus)
Core Concept: DNA contains triplet codes transcribed into single-stranded messenger RNA (mRNA) by RNA polymerase. DNA never leaves the nucleus; it is the protected master architecture.
1. The Blueprint: Transcription in the Nucleus
Focus: Nuclear protection & working transcript generation

Slide 8 • Build 2 2. The Assembly Line (Cytosol)
Core Concept: mRNA binds to the ribosome in the cytosol. The ribosome reads the code three letters at a time (codons) to assemble the product with strict reading frame fidelity.
2. The Assembly Line: Ribosomal Translation
Focus: Codon reading & peptide bond formation

Slide 8 • Build 3 3. The Cargo (tRNA)
Core Concept: Transfer RNA (tRNA) molecules are loaded with specific amino acids. The tRNA anticodon pairs complementarily with mRNA codons, building the polypeptide chain.
3. The Cargo: Amino Acid Activation & Delivery
Focus: Anticodon complementarity & primary sequence

Slide 8 • Build 4 4. Protein Conformation & Mutation
CRITICAL PRINCIPLE: Altering the DNA triplet changes the amino acid in the primary structure. Different R-group interactions disrupt tertiary folding—altering active site geometry and disabling function!
4. Conformation: Shape Dictates Function
Focus: Molecular causality & mutation disruption
